user_story: As a user, I want to be able to search for products on the product list page, so that I can quickly find the items I am interested in. Acceptance Criteria: When I enter a valid product name in the search input with id 'search_product' and click the search button with id 'submit_search', I should see a filtered list of products relevant to my search. If there are no matching products, I should see no products displayed.
